pages.quiz:
ENGLISH ACTIVITIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #13
====

GRADE: Grade 1
SUBJECT: ENGLISH ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which word is a verb? (1 mark)
   A. blue
   B. quickly
   C. run
   D. happiness

2. When practising Phonics, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Phonics.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Phonics.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Phonics.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Phonics.

3. When practising Pre-Writing, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Pre-Writing.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Pre-Writing.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Pre-Writing.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Pre-Writing.

4. When practising Attentive listening, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Attentive listening.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Attentive listening.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Attentive listening.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Attentive listening.

5. When practising Language School, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Language School.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Language School.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Language School.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Language School.

6. When practising Language Welcome and, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Language Welcome and.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Language Welcome and.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Language Welcome and.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Language Welcome and.

7. The past tense of “go” is: (1 mark)
   A. going
   B. goes
   C. went
   D. goed

8. When practising Connected text and fluency, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Connected text and fluency.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Connected text and fluency.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Connected text and fluency.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Connected text and fluency.

9. When practising Comprehension, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Comprehension.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Comprehension.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Comprehension.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Comprehension.

10. Choose the correctly punctuated sentence. (1 mark)
   A. Where is the library
   B. where is the library
   C. Where is the library?
   D. Where is the Library

11. A noun is a word that names: (1 mark)
   A. Only a joining word
   B. Only a describing word
   C. Only an action
   D. A person, place, thing, or idea

12. A paragraph should usually have: (1 mark)
   A. Many unrelated topics with no link
   B. Only one word repeated
   C. No full stops
   D. One main idea with supporting sentences

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Pre-Writing and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Handwriting and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Punctuation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Guided Writing and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
MARKING SCHEME
====

1. C — run

2. C — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Phonics.

3. B — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Pre-Writing.

4. A — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Attentive listening.

5. A — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Language School.

6. C — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Language Welcome and.

7. C — went

8. C — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Connected text and fluency.

9. B — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Comprehension.

10. C — Where is the library?

11. D — A person, place, thing, or idea

12. D — One main idea with supporting sentences

13. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Pre-Writing; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

14. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Handwriting; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

15. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Punctuation; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Guided Writing; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
